# Forms

Form components do not include labelling, error management and other visual elements.

- Use the generic <LinkTo kind="General/Forms" story="docs">Form Control</LinkTo> component to layout and decorate the form controls.
- See our <LinkTo kind="General/Forms/Examples" story="docs">Examples</LinkTo> to get an overview
